title: Quantification of Operando EC-STEM for Li-ion and Beyond Li-ion Battery Systems at Variable Temperatures
content: The demand to extend the driving range of electric vehicles has created a need for improved performance of Li-ion batteries, with both a higher energy density and a high-power capability being desirable. Accomplishing this requires the development and most importantly, the integration of new battery nanomaterials with high energy densities and highly stable electrolytes.
